Author:     Stephen King <sking@thunderbird.net>

    Bug 1978397 - Remove quoted strings from prefix-message for release-notify-started r=dandarnell
    
    - Formats prefix message
    - Adds try server config for prefix-message
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D259008

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/release_started.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/release_started.py
index a11553f7fd4..824fdcb0760 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/release_started.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/release_started.py
@@ -11,6 +11,8 @@ from shlex import quote as shell_quote
 from taskgraph.transforms.base import TransformSequence
 from taskgraph.util.schema import resolve_keyed_by
 
+from gecko_taskgraph.util.scriptworker import get_release_config
+
 transforms = TransformSequence()
 
 
@@ -19,12 +21,19 @@ def add_notifications(config, jobs):
     for job in jobs:
         label = "{}-{}".format(config.kind, job["name"])
 
+        release_config = get_release_config(config)
+        format_kwargs = dict(
+            config=config.__dict__,
+            release_config=release_config,
+        )
+
         resolve_keyed_by(job, "emails", label, project=config.params["project"])
         emails = [email.format(config=config.__dict__) for email in job.pop("emails")]
 
         resolve_keyed_by(job, "prefix-message", label, project=config.params["project"])
         prefix_message = ""
         if msg := job.pop("prefix-message"):
+            msg = msg.format(**format_kwargs)
             prefix_message = base64.b64encode(bytes(msg.encode("utf-8"))).decode()
 
         command = [
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-notify-started/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-notify-started/kind.yml
index f46c3cb45c0..608098ff3f9 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-notify-started/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-notify-started/kind.yml
@@ -26,8 +26,8 @@ task-defaults:
             default: []
     prefix-message:
         by-project:
-            comm-(beta|release|esr.*): |
-                "Thunderbird {release_config[version]} for the {config[params][project]} channel"
+            comm-(beta|release|esr.*): "Thunderbird {release_config[version]} for the {config[params][project]} channel"
+            try-comm-central: "Thunderbird {release_config[version]} for the {config[params][project]} channel"
             default: null
